notes: Backend is authoritative: holds all node_id/field_id, types, options, and branching rules (next/next_rules).
Frontend holds a parallel copy keyed by the SAME node_id/field_id/option_id, containing only display text per language (en/hi/ml). It never needs the branching rules.

Recommended: author ONE master file (this one). Backend uses it as-is. Frontend's translation dictionary is a separate file keyed by the same ids, generated/maintained alongside this one, so ids never drift out of sync.
Every field except RED_FLAG supports a free-text/voice escape option (see 'other' options below) per prior agreement.
Demographics (name/age/sex/language) are NOT re-asked here - already captured in the earlier Identify + Language steps and read from the Patient record when needed (e.g. LMP trigger).

v2.1: sex/gender is NOT a question in this bank - it comes from Patient.sex, populated from the (mocked) ABHA fetch for ABHA patients, or from an explicit sex-selection field asked once during Guest registration in the Identify step (outside this bank), since routing (e.g. the LMP overlay) depends on it either way.
